name: Oakland Parks, Recreation and Youth Development (OPRYD) Part-Time Jobs
what_you_do: You can apply for part-time and seasonal City recreation jobs. Jobs include recreation aide, recreation leader, sports official, lifeguard, water safety instructor and pool staff. There is also a recreation specialist job.
who_can_apply: The City is hiring for its recreation jobs. The page does not state a minimum age. It strongly encourages people who speak Spanish, Cantonese and Mandarin to apply.
pay_detail: Paid job. Not posted on the page; see each job posting
deadline_text: Deadline Oct 25, 2026 for Spring/Summer 2027 starts; Feb 7, 2027 for Summer 2027 starts; Aug 8, 2027 for Fall/Winter 2027 starts.
how_to_apply: Apply at governmentjobs.com/careers/oaklandca. Questions: parksandrec@oaklandca.gov or (510) 238-7275.
notes: The hiring process takes several months, so apply early. Check each posting for minimum age and pay. The governmentjobs.com/careers/oaklandca portal showed 0 openings on Oct 7, 2026. If you cannot find the posting, call (510) 238-7275.
